::: {#def-add-one-smoothing}

#### Add-one smoothing (Laplace smoothing)

**Add-one smoothing** (also called **Laplace smoothing**) adds 1 to every count before estimating a [bigram model](#def-bigram-model).
With $K$ possible symbols,
the estimate becomes

$$
\hPr{}\paren{X_t = b \given X_{t-1} = a} = \frac{N(a, b) + 1}{N(a) + K},
$$

so every pair gets a probability above 0,
including pairs the training text never shows
[@jurafsky2026slp, section 3.6.1].

:::
